# A platform collection agreement rarely covers every layer.

> Split a short-term rental stay's occupancy tax into what Airbnb or Vrbo already collects and what is left for the host to remit directly, layer by layer -- state, county, city, and a flat per-night fee. Free, private, nothing leaves your browser.

Free and open source (MIT). Results are estimates from the numbers typed in, not legal, tax, financial or professional advice.
